title: Tyrone Transformer
author: Wing
desc:
Tyrone Goals:
- 2 plate overhead press (100kg)
- 3 plate bench press (140kg)
- 3 plate pull-up (60kg)
- 4 plate squat (180kg)
- 4 plate RDLs (180kg)
- full-stack pulldown, OHE, leg press, calf press, leg curl, CSR
- Lateral raise 30kg
- Incline curl 30kg

ex.note:
- Lock and brace before lifting 
- Legs together and clench your glutes
- Touch chest and up keep ur back straight
- Head thru the bar on the way up
Stay humble on this one please

- Pushdowns and overhead extension Superset where you alternate between them 
- Use V-bar cable attachment for power days
- You will generally overhead extension less weight than you pushdown
